description: This source file contains unit tests for the TalkDirectiveParser component within the OpenClawKit project. It tests parsing of directive strings with various options and scenarios, verifying the correctness of the parsing logic and the extraction of directive fields.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveTests
classes.description: A test suite for testing the TalkDirectiveParser's parsing functionality, ensuring proper handling of directive strings with different formats and contents.

methods.name: testParsesDirectiveAndStripsLine
methods.description: Verifies that a correct directive JSON is parsed properly, extracting fields like voiceId and once, and strips the directive line from the text.

methods.name: testIgnoresNonDirective
methods.description: Ensures that non-directive lines are ignored and returned as-is without setting any directive.

methods.name: testKeepsDirectiveLineIfNoRecognizedFields
methods.description: Tests handling of directive JSON with unrecognized keys, confirming that it does not set a directive but still strips the line.

methods.name: testParsesExtendedOptions
methods.description: Checks parsing of a detailed directive JSON with numerous optional parameters, confirming each is correctly assigned.

methods.name: testSkipsLeadingEmptyLinesWhenParsingDirective
methods.description: Verifies that leading empty lines are skipped and the first directive line is correctly parsed.

methods.name: testTracksUnknownKeys
methods.description: Ensures unknown JSON keys are tracked separately when parsing directives.
